title: Check If A Number Is Majority Element In A Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array, determine if a target value appears more than N/2 times.
pseudocode:
1. n = nums.length
2. first = binarySearch(nums, target)
3. if first == -1 return false
4. last = first + n / 2
5. if last < n && nums[last] == target return true
6. return false

steps.note: Find first occurrence of target 5 using binary search
Calculate index for majority check (first + n/2 = 2 + 3 = 5)
Check if index 5 is within bounds and nums[5] is 5
Condition met: 5 is the majority element
